title: Knowledge base staleness detection and refresh
description: Monitors knowledge-base content, identifies stale or conflicting articles, refreshes them, and routes material changes for approval.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: knowledge-base-staleness-refresh
  title: Knowledge base staleness detection and refresh
  description: Monitors knowledge-base content, identifies stale or conflicting articles, refreshes them, and routes
    material changes for approval.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Keep knowledge content accurate, current, and aligned with authoritative sources.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - knowledge-owner
  nodes:
    - id: config
      kind: input
      name: Knowledge base and monitoring policy
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - articles
          - authoritativeSources
          - cadence
          - stalenessRules
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: monitor
      name: Poll authoritative sources
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Knowledge source monitor
      prompt: Poll the authoritative sources at the declared cadence and return dated changes relevant to the registered
        knowledge-base articles.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: detect
      kind: agent
      name: Detect stale content
      role: Knowledge manager
      prompt: Compare articles against authoritative sources and staleness rules. Flag outdated facts, broken links, missing
        policies, and contradictions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: refresh
      kind: agent
      name: Draft article refreshes
      role: Technical writer
      prompt: Update only verified stale sections. Preserve article intent, add citations, and list material changes.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: review
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Material-change gate
      role: Knowledge reviewer
      prompt: Return passed when no material changes require owner review; otherwise return failed with affected articles.
      config:
        threshold: 1
    - id: knowledge-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Knowledge owner approves refreshed content
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Refreshed knowledge-base articles and staleness register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: config
      to: monitor
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: monitor
      to: detect
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: config
      to: detect
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: detect
      to: refresh
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: refresh
      to: review
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: review
      to: result
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e7
      from: review
      to: knowledge-owner
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e8
      from: knowledge-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
